heading: Department of Energy oversight of cooperative agreements relating to Initiative

tree.heading: Provisions relating to disapproval and modification of agreements
tree.text: If the Secretary of Energy desires an opportunity to disapprove or require the modification of any agreement under section 4627 of this title, the agreement shall provide a 90-day period within which such action may be taken, beginning on the date the agreement is submitted to the Secretary.

tree.heading: Record of agreements
tree.text: Each national laboratory shall maintain a record of all agreements entered into under this section.
